# gravity-piece-ai

**Auto-generated — do not hand-edit.** A renamed copy of `@activepieces/piece-ai@0.4.4` carrying the Gravity OpenRouter cost-metering (fork patch P-004). Published to public npm so a runtime-fetch AP can run the metered piece (the official package can't).

Regenerate: `node tools/scripts/gen-gravity-piece-ai.mjs`. Auto-published by `.github/workflows/gravity-piece-ai-autopublish.yml` on each `ai` version bump.

Flows must reference `gravity-piece-ai` instead of `@activepieces/piece-ai` — handled by the clone-time piece-name rewrite in core (`flow-tree.ts`).
